title: What's new in Expense Agent: Travel and Expense Policy Automation (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Policy compliance settings and AI evaluation options
Expense policy categories and presubmission evaluation
Expense agent dashboard and compliance status
Policy validation examples - hotel and flight expenses
Submitter-initiated policy checking and receipt itemization
Approver workflow and policy override requirements

features.name: Evaluate compliance with AI
features.description: A new toggle in policy compliance settings that uses copilot credits to analyze free text expense policies and help approvers make decisions about submitted expenses.

features.name: Presubmission evaluation
features.description: Allows expense submitters to run policy checks against their own expense reports before submitting them to approvers, helping them fix compliance issues in advance.
caveats: Can be disabled by administrators if concerned about AI credit usage

features.name: Policy compliance flagging
features.description: New status indicator that marks expense reports with flagged policies - policies that have been evaluated and found potential non-compliance, requiring approver attention.

features.name: Policy validation with free text rules
features.description: System accepts free text expense policies organized by category that AI analyzes against submitted expenses to evaluate compliance with company rules.
caveats: Multiple policies per category should be separate lines for better AI analysis
Policies only as detailed as available receipt information

features.name: Policy check with AI button
features.description: Submitter-initiated action to run AI policy evaluation against expense report before submission, providing status update on whether expenses comply with configured policies.
caveats: Takes approximately one minute to evaluate

features.name: Enhanced receipt itemization
features.description: Upcoming feature to provide more detailed itemization of receipts so AI policy evaluation has complete information needed, for example to detect specific items like alcoholic beverages.

features.name: Policy version tracking
features.description: System tracks which version of a receipt policies are evaluated against - when an expense is modified, policies revert to pending status requiring re-evaluation.
caveats: Requires manual re-evaluation after changes to expenses

features.name: Policy override with audit trail
features.description: Upcoming requirement for approvers to specify a reason when overriding a policy violation, with reasons kept in Business Central audit records for compliance tracking.

features.name: Intelligent policy check optimization
features.description: System does not run policy checks if there are no policies configured or if the expense record has not changed since the last evaluation, reducing unnecessary AI credit usage.
